title: Agent Operating Contract Machine Projection
migration_phase: PHASE-5-target; docs/AGENTS.md remains operating contract until explicit promotion
purpose: Machine-readable projection of the agent operating contract so root-hub discovery can point to the future PHASE-5 JSON target without prematurely demoting docs/AGENTS.md authority.

authority_boundary.projection_use: Discovery, validation planning, and migration readiness only
authority_boundary.not_allowed: Do not cite this projection as superseding docs/AGENTS.md until PHASE-5 promotion lands with evidence.

required_sequence: read docs/AGENTS.md for the live operating contract
create one isolated git worktree branch per agent lane before edits
verify with the smallest evidence loop that proves the completion claim
open a pull request against dev with Buck2 evidence and wait for trusted Prow/Kubernetes-native oya-ci-required admission before merge

agent_completion_contract.must_continue_until: requested local branch is implemented or a concrete blocker is documented
must_not_do: ask for permission on safe reversible next steps
modify individual ADR files during index-only gardening
modify individual microservice, persona, or journey files during hub README gardening
evidence_required: Buck2/Prow PR evidence or explicit blocker

hyperscaler_grade_rigor.named_precedent: Google-style mono-repo agent operating contract plus Kubernetes-style admission gates: a readable policy source with machine-checkable admission transitions.

failure_modes.behavior: root guidance remains discoverable through README/CLAUDE/AGENTS pointers and VCS gates reject unclaimed edits when policy is enforced
projection is non-authoritative until PHASE-5 and must be reconciled before promotion
native SCM/worktree lease + PR evidence records scope; Buck2 and Prow/Kubernetes-native oya-ci-required record admission evidence before promotion. Do not revive oya vcs CLI.

observability_hooks: GitHub PR adapter status while the temporary bridge remains
Buck2 and Prow/Kubernetes-native oya-ci-required evidence strings
hyperscaler_grade_rigor.rollback_path: Revert this projection or reset root-hub pointer fields while keeping docs/AGENTS.md as current authority.
hyperscaler_grade_rigor.versioning: Schema-compatible additive changes until PHASE-5; breaking authority promotion requires ADR/update evidence.
